response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg), g AS (SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) AS txn_count FROM j GROUP BY ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM g), b AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share FROM s) SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, share, share - baseline_share AS share_above_baseline FROM b WHERE share > baseline_share ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Share is a fraction between 0 and 1 (count divided by the total of the per-mix distinct counts), not a percentage, and the 'above baseline' difference is in the same fraction units.
Records with a NULL ordertypedist form their own group (shown as NULL) and count as one mix in the total and the baseline average. Empty-string values are not treated as missing.
The total across all mixes is taken over the matched (inner-joined) transactions only. Each transaction has one mix, so the sum of per-mix distinct counts equals the distinct total.
